hero.tagline: I build REST APIs with Laravel, the Vue.js interfaces that consume them, and React Native apps published on Google Play.

about.label: About
about.title: From database schema to phone screen
about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer based in Agadir, with over three years on the Laravel / Vue.js stack. My work usually starts with modelling: understanding the domain, translating it into a relational schema, then building the REST API that exposes it cleanly.
about.p2: On the interface side I consume those APIs with Vue.js and, on mobile, with React Native and Expo — five apps I've built are live on Google Play today. I've worked remotely for teams in Canada and Morocco, in Agile, alongside product and design.
about.p3: I fold AI-assisted development into my daily workflow — generation, review and refactoring — to ship faster without giving up readable code.

rami-marocain.tagline: Moroccan card game against an AI
rami-marocain.desc: Moroccan Rami as a native app: play against an AI with runs, sets and jokers — no sign-up needed.
rami-marocain.body: Rami Marocain brings the traditional Moroccan card game to mobile. The heart of the project is the game logic: validating combinations (runs, sets, jokers), managing turns, and an AI opponent that plays a credible hand. The interface is built for touch in landscape, with fluid card rendering and animation. The app is free and playable immediately, with no account and no connection required.

tidenow.desc: Tide data by station: hourly curves, high and low tides, moon phases and saved favourite stations.
tidenow.body: TideNow shows the state of the tide for a given station, anywhere in the world. It pulls data from official stations, plots the day's tide curve with the current level, and lists upcoming high and low tides. A map lets you browse available stations by region, with a favourites system to keep your own. A dedicated module shows moon phases, sunrise and sunset — useful for fishing and navigation.

parkpin.tagline: Find your car, in one tap
parkpin.desc: Saves your parking spot by GPS, gives walking directions back, and reminds you before the meter runs out.
parkpin.body: ParkPin solves one simple problem: where is my car. A single tap records the exact GPS position of your parking spot, with no typing. The app then shows distance, direction and a walking route back. You can add the address, floor or bay number in a covered car park, attach a photo of the spot, and set a reminder before your parking time expires. It handles multiple vehicles and keeps a history of previous parking spots.

bimma-ewd.tagline: Mobile app published on Android and iOS
bimma-ewd.desc: Mobile app published on Google Play and the App Store: search, favourites and offline browsing.
bimma-ewd.body: Bimma EWD is a React Native mobile app published on both stores. It offers catalogue search, favourites, and offline access to already-loaded content. A Laravel backend exposes the REST API the app consumes, with particular attention paid to perceived performance and user experience on both Android and iOS.

scantel.desc: Reads phone recharge codes automatically via OCR, with a stripped-back flow for non-technical users.
scantel.body: Recharge Scanner removes the manual typing of phone top-up codes. The camera detects and reads the code automatically via OCR, without the user having to frame it precisely or copy a string of digits. The work focused on fine-grained Android permission handling, detection reliability under varying lighting, and a flow reduced to the bare minimum for non-technical users.

cod-delivery-man.desc: Order management, status tracking and payment collection, synced with a Laravel backend.
cod-delivery-man.body: COD Delivery Man is the courier-facing app for a cash-on-delivery service. It lists assigned orders, lets couriers advance their status through the round, and records payment collection. Synchronisation runs through a Laravel REST API with MySQL on the server side. The app is built with Ionic and Capacitor on top of a Vue.js codebase.

elevateguru.desc: SaaS platform for project management and collaboration between entrepreneurs and business advisors.
elevateguru.body: ElevateGuru connects entrepreneurs with business advisors around a shared workspace: project tracking, training paths, impact measurement and decision support. The work covered refactoring an existing CakePHP codebase, backend performance optimisation, WebSockets integration for real-time exchanges, PDF report generation via Puppeteer with a queue, plus Docker containerisation and a progressive migration to Laravel / Vue.js.

ma3ahid.desc: Enrolment, payments, roles and permissions, scheduling and invoicing on a domain-driven relational schema.
ma3ahid.body: Ma3ahid is a management application for training institutions. It covers student enrolment, payment tracking and invoicing, session scheduling, and a roles-and-permissions system separating administration, teachers and staff. The core of the project is the relational schema: turning real operating rules into database constraints and business validation on the Laravel side.

agriwise.desc: Business application for agricultural tracking: field data, complex queries and report exports.
agriwise.body: Agriwise is a web management application for the agricultural sector. I developed the backend in Laravel — MVC architecture, business rules and documented REST APIs for third-party integration — along with the design and optimisation of the MySQL database: relational tables, migrations, complex queries and operational report exports.

azora-shop.desc: A modern e-commerce platform built for a smooth, multilingual and responsive shopping experience.
azora-shop.body: Azora Shop is an e-commerce platform built with Nuxt.js. It handles the product catalogue, category navigation and cart, with centralised state through Pinia and a multilingual interface via i18n. The presentation layer uses PrimeVue and Tailwind CSS for a consistent, responsive interface.
